Name: Tyrant
Effect: When this Pokémon enters battle, allied Pokémon will gain +1 Bonus Dice to the Damage Pool of their Moves, additionally this Pokémon won’t receive Damage from Moves performed by its allied Pokémon, however this Pokémon will do +1 Dice of Damage to its allied Pokémon should it hit them. (Note: Replaces the Hidden Ability of Tyrantrum and ability of Mega Tyranitar)
